parameters.name: AliyunLang
parameters.description:
The language. Valid values:

*   zh (default value): Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ConfigYaml
parameters.description: The YAML configuration file of the ServiceMonitor.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Checks whether the format is valid and whether targets are matched.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace where the PodMonitor resides.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-env-pod-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --aliyun-lang zh --environment-id env-xxxxx --namespace arms-prom --pod-monitor-name arms-admin-pm1 --dry-run true --config-yaml '参见补充说明。' --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UpdateEnvPodMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --PodMonitorName 'arms-admin-pm1' --EnvironmentId 'env-xxxxx' --DryRun true --AliyunLang zh --ConfigYaml '参见补充说明。' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace 'arms-prom'
